description: After Premier Danielle Smith and Prime Minister Mark Carney unveiled an official proposal for an oil pipeline to the West Coast on Thursday, one pollster sees the opportunity to win over a narrow group of undecided referendum voters, while some groups supporting the province's independence don't put much stock in the deal.
title: Will Alberta pipeline proposal move voters ahead of separation vote?

description: This week, those looking for a summer blockbuster may be disappointed to see plenty of screen times for Minions & Monsters and … not much else. Here's a list of recent releases which — depending on your tastes — should be worth your time.
title: From Elle to Obsession: your weekend watch cheat sheet

description: Generations of Canada’s political class have summited at the “Greatest Outdoor Show on Earth” to shake hands and flip pancakes. This year’s festival arrives with a looming referendum on Alberta’s future within Canada and, as of Thursday night, a multibillion-dollar pipeline bid.
title: Pancakes, pipelines and independence: politics serving up new flavour at this year’s Calgary Stampede

description: Energy Minister Tim Hodgson says a second pipeline to the West Coast will be money well-spent for the federal government but can't say how much Ottawa would be on the hook for.
title: Taxpayers could be on hook for West Coast pipeline, but it's a 'good investment': Energy minister

description: An inmate and a corrections officer at Toronto South Detention Centre were investigated for potential involvement in the alleged conspiracy to kill a senior corrections officer at the jail, which sparked Project South, according to an Information to Obtain (ITO) application for more than 50 warrants in the police investigation.
title: Inmate and jail guard investigated, but not charged in Project South alleged murder plot

description: In response to U.S. President Donald Trump’s threats to take over Greenland, organizers of Denmark’s Fourth of July celebration have barred U.S. officials from taking part.
title: Denmark uninvites American officials from its big 4th of July bash

description: As the Vatican excommunicated four bishops of the ultra-traditionalist Society of Saint Pius X this week, notice was also served that the society’s priests and lay Catholics who formally adhere to it are also considered cut off from the Roman Catholic Church — a move that raises the spiritual stakes for thousands of followers worldwide.
title: Pope Leo draws hard line on breakaway traditionalists, but it could get messy

description: Canada midfielder Ismaël Koné felt like he had let the country down as he lay stricken on the pitch with a broken leg, but has remained around the squad to offer his support ahead of their World ​Cup last-16 game against Morocco in Houston on Saturday.
title: Canada's Koné feels the love after shocking World Cup injury

description: The cost of the new Gordie Howe bridge connecting Windsor and Detroit is still $6.4 billion despite multiple delays, according to the federal authority that oversees the bridge.
title: Gordie Howe bridge cost still $6.4B despite delays, federal authority says

description: In the house where police found two dead brothers — both boys believed to have been murdered by their father Mohammed Al-Lami before he died by suicide — investigators found a note left on the desk of Al-Lami's office, CBC News has learned.
title: Angry note left at scene of double murder of sons insisted father was the victim

description: A chemotherapy ingredient that's in short supply in Canada can temporarily be imported and sold from a Chinese-authorized source instead, Health Canada says.
title: Health Canada permits temporary import of Chinese-authorized chemo injection drug amid critical shortage

description: A pair of Winter Olympians traded their skis and skates for hats and boots Friday as the Calgary Stampede parade kicked off 10 days of western-themed festivities.
title: Calgary Stampede parade kicks off 10 days of western fun

description: The Big Apple has been sparkling a little brighter these past few days with celebrity friends and family of Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce spotted in the city — presumably for the superstar couple’s expected wedding today at Madison Square Garden.
title: Celebrities descend on Manhattan as Taylor Swift wedding frenzy continues

description: Elections Alberta has rejected musician Corb Lund's 'Water Not Coal' petition, saying it failed to meet the requirements for a citizen initiative petition.
title: Elections Alberta rejects Corb Lund's 'Water Not Coal' petition

description: More than 2,000 Quebec households are still without a home following the province's July 1 moving day. Housing advocates say the increase compared to last year shows that building more apartments isn't enough to solve the affordability crisis.
title: More than 2,000 Quebec households stranded without a lease after July 1

description: The body of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei lay in state in a vast hall in Tehran on Friday as clerics, officials, foreign dignitaries and other mourners paid their respects to Iran's late Supreme Lea
title: Iran begins week of funeral ceremonies for Ayatollah Ali Khamenei

description: Tommy Hunter, the celebrated Canadian country musician, has died. He was 89.
title: Tommy Hunter, 'Canada's Country Gentleman,' dead at 89

description: The U.S. envoy to Canada says 14 months of trade talk between Canada and the Trump administration has resolved few issues. But Pete Hoekstra insists the Americans will keep talking in the hopes of striking an agreement on the future of CUSMA, as well as settling other issues.
title: Hoekstra says no 'significant progress' in 14 months of trade negotiations, but U.S. to keep talking

description: Canada Post says it is suspending service to some European Union countries over new customs rules for low-value shipments, saying it's not accepting parcels destined for a dozen countries until further notice.
title: Canada Post stopping parcel delivery to some EU countries because of new duty
Ontario couple sentenced to life in prison for murdering boy 'got what they deserved,' brother tells court
Sentencing set to begin for Ontario couple guilty of boy's murder, brother's torture

description: Interpol on Friday named the suspect in the Monaco bombing that is thought to have targeted a Ukrainian tycoon with links to Russia.
title: Interpol names suspect in Monaco bombing that reportedly wounded Russia-linked tycoon

description: Interpol on Friday identified a 39-year-old woman from Ukraine as the main suspect in a bombing in Monaco that is thought to have targeted a Ukrainian tycoon with links to Russia.
title: Interpol names suspect in Monaco bombing that reportedly wounded Russia-linked tycoon

description: In part two of our documentary on Mark Carney’s defence strategy: what could happen when the world comes knocking on the Canadian defence industry’s door?
title: Canada’s massive military buildup: Part 2

description: Paintings of SpongeBob and his friends on large boulders along the shoreline in Margaretsville, N.S., have some fans, but others want to see them removed.
title: Art or graffiti? Beachside paintings of cartoons spark conversation in scenic N.S. community

description: In May, Brandy Cooney and Becky Hamber of Burlington, Ont., were found guilty of murdering a boy in their care, and assaulting and confining his younger brother. Today, they'll be sentenced in Milton, and it's possible the court will hear victim impact statements.
title: Burlington, Ont., couple guilty of murdering boy, torturing brother to be sentenced today

description: Craig Waddell's family has been farming on Mitch Owens Road for six generations, but they say truck traffic and dangerous driving now has them facing close calls almost daily.
title: Farmer feels lucky to be alive after semi rear-ended his tractor at high speed

description: Nine months after Hamas and Israel agreed to a hard-fought ceasefire in Gaza, the term has become a cruel irony for the two million Palestinians trapped inside the territory.
title: Gaza has become frozen in 'humanitarian purgatory' — and it could get worse

description: It was dubbed "the most Ottawa story of all time" a decade ago. CBC News caught up with the girls at the centre of the lemonade stand controversy that swept the capital in the summer of 2016.
title: Lemonade stand girls reflect on 'most Ottawa story of all time' 10 years later

description: An Indian sea captain who was stuck on an oil tanker in the Persian Gulf for more than two months as the U.S. and Israel-Iran war raged says thousands of mariners are still at risk and don’t get the recognition they deserve.
title: ‘We are pawns’: Indian sea captain fears for other seafarers still stuck in Persian Gulf
